summary.text: Joseph Elison is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 72 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Elison is a business owner who lives in Washington County.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Elison lives in Washington County, Utah, and graduated from Hurricane High School.
His career experience includes owning a business, and he served as president of the Hurricane Valley Rotary Club.
Elison took office in 2023, succeeding Rex Shipp in District 72.
